name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: An avatar drawn in glyphs: initials set over a lit disc of Braille dots, or a photo sampled into a glyph portrait, with a status glyph and overlapping groups.

name: divider
title: Divider
description: A horizontal or vertical rule drawn in box-drawing glyphs or a repeating glyph pattern, with an optional label or ornament.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: A box-drawing line drawing (an inbox, a search, a folder or an unplugged cable) with a title, a description and an action, for views with nothing in them yet.

name: loader
title: Loader
description: A loading indicator drawn in glyphs: a spinner from six glyph sequences, walking dots, an eighth-block wave or a Braille comet.

name: logo-marquee
title: Logo marquee
description: Logos sampled into glyph art, in a row that loops and pauses on hover, or a still wall.

name: not-found
title: Not found
description: A complete 404 block: the code in big block glyphs with a shaded extrusion under a field of stars, a shell line for the failed path, a message and actions.

name: progress-bar
title: Progress bar
description: A progress bar drawn in eighth-block glyphs, exact to an eighth of a cell, with stacked parts, step segments and an indeterminate comet.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders for text, blocks and avatars made of shade glyphs, with a band of denser glyphs that sweeps across the page.

name: stat-card
title: Stat card
description: A KPI card in a box-drawing frame with a big number, a coloured ▲ or ▼ delta and an eighth-block sparkline.
